result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of repositories committed to in the past 90 days, not the 180-day figure.

**Change:** in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` (around line 906), the LOC text for the "past 90d" block was built from `loc180Days`. It now uses `loc90Days`, the same variable as its percentage and repository count.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl reports compile` and `mvn -o -pl reports test` both succeed with no output. The reports module has no test that covers this generator, so I did not check the rendered figure. Your example (500 LOC committed last week, 2,000 LOC last committed four months ago) should now give "past 180d" 2.5K LOC and "past 90d" 500 LOC.

Nothing was committed.
